# SYNTHETIC packets in the shape the SMC-PAD is expected to produce over BLE, built by hand from
# the USB measurements in mvave-smc-pad-ableton/docs/HARDWARE.md. This is NOT a recording.
# Real captures from scripts/record_packets.py go in their own files next to this one.
#
# Format: one packet per line, hex bytes, '#' starts a comment. Every *.txt in this directory is
# decoded by tests/test_parser.py and must produce no parser errors.
#
# Launcher preset as measured over USB: pads are notes 1-16 in reading order, buttons 17-21,
# channel 1 (0 on the wire). Press = note-on velocity 127, release = note-on velocity 0.
# Encoders are relative, centre-64: 63 = one click counter-clockwise, 65 = one click clockwise.

86 C1 90 01 7F                      # pad 1 press at 833 ms
87 B9 90 01 00                      # pad 1 release at 953 ms, note-on velocity 0
88 80 90 10 7F 85 10 00             # pad 16 tap: press at 1024, release at 1029 via running status
89 90 90 11 7F                      # play button (note 17) press at 1168
89 A4 90 11 00                      # play button release at 1188
8A 80 B0 07 41                      # encoder 1, bank 1 (CC 7): one click clockwise
8A 82 B0 07 3F                      # encoder 1, bank 1 (CC 7): one click counter-clockwise
8A 90 B0 07 41 92 07 41 94 07 41    # three clicks in one packet, running status with timestamps
8B 80 B0 0A 3F 0A 3F 0A 3F          # encoder 8, bank 2 (CC 10): three clicks, timestamps inherited
